digest.component_or_area: Documentation tooling and config reference generation
propositions: A new generator script must read config schema, deprecation registry, and secret names to produce two fully-generated documentation files without modifying the existing hand-authored config.md
Generated docs must carry a self-announcing banner naming the generator command and be registered in both the generated-surface-markers test registry and the docs/README.md parity table
A drift-detection test must validate that generated docs match their sources via a --check mode that handles newline normalization for cross-platform checkout compatibility

All required documentation topics (precedence, source, lifecycle, rotation, refresh, observability, subprocess limits, behavior deltas, MCP/CLI exposure) must be present as anchors across both generated docs
The existing docs/config.md and all its content-asserting test consumers must remain unchanged and continue to pass by construction
